AgentConfig.description:
The full, admin-editable configuration of one agent (stored as JSON).

``v`` accepts ``1`` for one release: v1 rows are rewritten to v2 by the
``v2_008_agentconfig_v2`` migration, and the console still posts ``v: 1``
until WP-3 lands.

default.greeting: Hello! How can I help you today?

AgentConfig.title: AgentConfig

AppsMode.description:
``AgentConfig.tools.apps``: how the agent uses connected apps (docs/v5/COMPOSIO.md D-V5-C6).

The default ``off`` changes nothing for an agent saved before this field existed.

allowed_toolkits.description: Apps the app server or tool finder may use (toolkit slugs); empty = every connected app of the agent
allowed_toolkits.title: Allowed Toolkits

denied_actions.description: Actions the app server or tool finder must never run (action slugs)
denied_actions.title: Denied Actions

reviewed_actions.description: Destructive actions the builder has decided about (action slugs, R-V5-9); denied_actions says which way. An unreviewed destructive action is blocked
reviewed_actions.title: Reviewed Actions

AppsMode.title: AppsMode

manage_connections.description: Let the agent offer a sign-in link for an app that is not connected yet (text and web chats only: a phone caller cannot open a link)
manage_connections.title: Manage Connections

search.description: Let the agent look actions up during the conversation
search.title: Search

AppsRouterOptions.title: AppsRouterOptions

``id`` keys the block's state in :attr:`UiState.blocks`; ``config`` is

EndNode.title: EndNode

EndpointingOptions.title: EndpointingOptions

FlowEdge.description: A conditional transition; ``condition`` becomes the handoff tool description.
FlowEdge.title: FlowEdge

FlowSpec.description: The whole graph, validated structurally on construction.
FlowSpec.title: FlowSpec

GlobalNode.description: Instructions, tools and knowledge merged into every agent node.

HttpToolDefinition.description: An HTTP call exposed to the model as a raw-schema function tool.
HttpToolDefinition.title: HttpToolDefinition

InterruptionOptions.description: How the caller interrupts the agent (SDK ``InterruptionOptions``, ``turn.py:150``).
InterruptionOptions.title: InterruptionOptions

McpHeaderAuth.description:
Static request headers, typically an API key (research-v4 tools §4.3.1).

Header values may reference ``{{ secret.NAME }}``; the api substitutes them from
``credential_id`` (an ``http-tool-secret`` bag) when a session resolves.
McpHeaderAuth.title: McpHeaderAuth

McpNoAuth.description: The MCP server needs no credentials (a public server).
McpNoAuth.title: McpNoAuth

McpOAuthAuth.description:
Sign in through the server's OAuth provider (V5-14; saved only once V5-14 lands).

The api is the OAuth client: it runs discovery, registration, consent and the token
exchange, keeps the tokens in an ``mcp-oauth`` credential, and hands the worker a
short-lived access token at session start (research-v4 tools §4.3).
McpOAuthAuth.title: McpOAuthAuth

McpServerDefinition.description:
A streamable-HTTP MCP server attached to the agent.

``auth`` says how the worker authenticates. ``headers`` and ``credential_id`` are the
pre-V5-09 shape, kept as **deprecated mirrors** of header auth so readers that have not
moved to ``auth`` yet keep working: a definition that sets them without ``auth`` (or
with ``auth.kind == "none"``) folds them into :class:`McpHeaderAuth`; with ``auth`` set
they are filled from it (``credential_id`` also mirrors an OAuth credential), and a
value that disagrees with ``auth`` is an error. Stored rows need no data migration:
they load as header auth and re-save with ``auth``.
McpServerDefinition.title: McpServerDefinition

McpServerOrigin.description: Where a provider-provisioned MCP server comes from (docs/v5/COMPOSIO.md §3).
McpServerOrigin.title: McpServerOrigin

McpToolSnapshot.description: One tool of a server's ``tools/list`` answer, as ``POST /v1/tools/{id}/test`` stored it.
McpToolSnapshot.title: McpToolSnapshot

ModelCapabilities.description:
What one model can do, as far as the platform knows (D-V4-24, R-V4-23).

``None`` means unknown. Resolved per field from, in order: the admin's
declaration, the last "Test model" probe, the live catalog item's
metadata, the registry; ``source`` names the source of ``vision``.
ModelCapabilities.title: ModelCapabilities

PanelLayout.description: Which panel renders the session, and (for ``composite``) its blocks.
PanelLayout.title: PanelLayout

PipelineConfig.description:
Which providers fill which slot, and how turns are handled.

Slot requirements per mode are reported by :func:`pipeline_issues` rather
than raised here: the api returns them as a ``ValidationResult`` so a
half-finished pipeline can still be saved as a draft.
PipelineConfig.title: PipelineConfig

PreemptiveGenerationOptions.description: Start the reply before the caller's turn is confirmed (SDK ``turn.py:201``).
PreemptiveGenerationOptions.title: PreemptiveGenerationOptions

ProviderRef.description: Points at a registry provider plus the credential and options to use.
ProviderRef.title: ProviderRef

ProviderToolDefinition.description:
One action of a connected app run through a tool provider (docs/v5/COMPOSIO.md §3, D-V5-C8).

Created by materialisation (``POST /v1/tool-providers/composio/materialise``): the
parameters are pinned from the provider's schema at import, the description is its first
sentence (editable). The worker runs it with ``POST /api/v3.1/tools/execute/{tool_slug}``
on the provider's host. ``headers`` carry the provider key as a ``{{ secret.NAME }}``
placeholder that the api substitutes from ``credential_id`` when a session resolves, as
for HTTP tools; ``connection_id`` is the connected-app row, ``subject`` the provider's
``user_id`` copied from it.
ProviderToolDefinition.title: ProviderToolDefinition

QaConfig.description: Post-call scoring of the session by an LLM judge.
QaConfig.title: QaConfig

QaNode.description: Post-call scoring step; never part of the conversational graph.
QaNode.title: QaNode

RecordingConfig.description: Whether and where the session is recorded through Egress.

ResolvedProvider.description: A provider ready to construct: class path plus complete constructor kwargs.

StartNode.description: Entry point: greets the caller and hands off along its first matching edge.
StartNode.title: StartNode

ToolExecution.description:
How one tool runs relative to the conversation (BACKGROUND-TOOLS.md §2).

The agent-level default (``ToolsConfig.execution_default``) only ever reaches read
tools: GET HTTP tools and the built-ins in :data:`BACKGROUNDABLE_BUILTINS`. The
tools in :data:`NEVER_BACKGROUND_TOOLS` and the flow edge tools always block.
ToolExecution.title: ToolExecution

ToolsConfig.description: Built-in tool gating plus references to admin-authored tool rows.
ToolsConfig.title: ToolsConfig

TransferNode.description: Hands the call to a human or another number.
TransferNode.title: TransferNode

TransferTarget.description: One destination the agent may transfer a caller to.

label.description: What the model and the caller call it
label.title: Label

TransferTarget.title: TransferTarget

TurnDetectorSettings.description:
``PipelineConfig.turn_detector``: the end-of-turn model's placement and sensitivity.

Applies to the LiveKit turn detector (``inference.TurnDetector``, 1.8.3
``inference/eot/detector.py:35-47``) and to the local plugin model, on top of the
connection's ``turn_detector_mode``: a connection without hosted Inference always
runs the local model, whatever ``mode`` says.
TurnDetectorSettings.title: TurnDetectorSettings

UserTurnLimitOptions.description: Stop a caller who talks too long without a reply (SDK ``turn.py:231``; off by default).
UserTurnLimitOptions.title: UserTurnLimitOptions

VariableSpec.description: One variable a flow extracts from the conversation.
VariableSpec.title: VariableSpec

description:
What the worker receives from ``/internal/v1/sessions/{id}/resolved``.

Contains decrypted credentials in ``resolved[*].kwargs`` and substituted tool
secrets in ``tools``. Never log this object.

The v2 additions all carry defaults so a v1 api (before V2-01/V2-03 land)
still produces a valid document.
title: ResolvedAgentConfig
